description: Shared project_docs.files parity fixture. The Rust daemon (crates/daemon/src/config.rs), the OpenCode plugin loader (packages/opencode-plugin/src/config/index.ts), and the Pi plugin loader (packages/pi-plugin/src/config/index.ts) load every row through their production loaders and must agree on the document list the user tier sets.
contract: A row's user tier is written as eidnara.jsonc under the user config directory and its project tier as <project>/.eidnara/eidnara.jsonc; an empty object writes an empty document.

expected_files is the effective list: the user tier's admissible list, or the default ["ARCHITECTURE.md", "STRUCTURE.md"] when the user tier sets none. The key is user-only, so the project tier never changes it.

expected_project_warning is true when the project tier sets project_docs.files; every loader then reports, exactly once, that it ignored the key from the project tier. A project block that leaves the list unset changes nothing and draws no warning.
The plugins pass the user tier's list through without admission, so every row's user list is admissible; refused entries are the daemon's alone and are covered by its configuration tests.

rows.name: the user tier names nested documents
the user tier names no documents
the project block leaves the list unset
